---
title: "Publications"
listing:
  id: publications
  contents:
    - publications-listing.yml
  template: _ejs/publication.ejs.md
  sort:
    - "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  categories: true
  page-size: 20
  field-display-names:
    date: "Year"
    title: "Title"
---

<!--
  How this page works
  ═══════════════════
  1. publications.bib        — exported/synced from Zotero (Better BibTeX)
  2. links.yml               — per-paper links keyed by BibTeX citekey
  3. scripts/bib_to_yaml.py  — pre-render script that combines 1 + 2
                                into publications-listing.yml
  4. _ejs/publication.ejs.md — custom listing template

  Adding a new publication:
    a. Add / sync the entry in Zotero → publications.bib updates
    b. (Optional) add links in links.yml using the citekey
    c. Run `quarto render` — the pre-render script regenerates
       _publications.yml automatically
-->

::: {#publications}
:::
